BrainIAC_ViT_B16.official_architecture: MONAI ViT (in_channels=1, img_size=(96,96,96), patch_size=(16,16,16), hidden_size=768, num_layers=12, num_heads=12)
BrainIAC_ViT_B16.provenance_notes: Official 88.4M ViT-B/16 safetensors backbone loaded without mismatch. Input interpolated from 128^3 to 96^3. Supersedes historical 6.5M CNN toy proxy.

MONAI_Swin_UNETR_SSL.provenance_notes: Official MONAI SwinViT backbone correctly remapped. Disclosed CT pretraining provenance; evaluated as cross-modality volumetric pretraining transfer.

FOMO25_AMAES_ResEnc_B.official_architecture: Asparagus ResEnc-B (dimensions='3D', input_channels=1, output_channels=1, 6 residual stages: 32, 64, 128, 256, 320, 320)

FOMO25_AMAES_ResEnc_B.provenance_notes: All 448 official encoder keys loaded strictly from PyTorch Lightning checkpoint. Bottleneck stage 5 representation (320-d) pooled via adaptive average pooling.

Random_ViT_B16_Control.provenance_notes: Identical ViT-B/16 architecture trained in frozen probe mode without pretrained weights to isolate self-supervised pretraining effect.
